questions.stem: At what level does a Paladin learn Holy Strike?
questions.explanation: Holy Strike arrives at level 6. Seal of Fury and Righteous Fury come at 10, and Consecration and Blessing of Kings become baseline at 20.

questions.stem: How long is Lay on Hands' cooldown in Forever?
questions.explanation: Lay on Hands drops from a 1-hour to a 20-minute cooldown.

questions.stem: Which of these did Blizzard remove from the Paladin class?
questions.explanation: Blessing of Light was removed with Salvation, Mass Salvation and Revoke. Blessing of Kings is now baseline at 20, and Righteous Fury is trained at 10.

questions.stem: How far do the Fire, Frost and Shadow Resistance Auras reach?
questions.explanation: They reach raid members within 30 yards. Ten yards is the range of the Seal of Fury Judgement taunt.

questions.stem: Which talent replaces the old Twist of Light capstone?
questions.explanation: Unsealed Wrath is a 31-point Retribution talent that requires Repentance. Oath of Light and Boundless Light are new Holy talents.

questions.stem: Which quest grants Redemption?
questions.explanation: The Tome of Divinity (level 12) grants Redemption. The Tome of Valor (20) teaches Sense Undead, and Must be Delgren (22) is an unconfirmed report.

questions.stem: Who forges Verigan's Fist?
questions.explanation: Jordan Stilwell forges Verigan's Fist in The Test of Righteousness. Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker starts the Classic Summon Charger chain.

questions.stem: Sources disagree on Summon Warhorse at level 40. What does Warcraft Tavern list it as?
questions.explanation: Warcraft Tavern lists Summon Warhorse as a trainer unlock alongside Apprentice Riding; warcraft.wiki.gg links it to The Tome of Nobility.

questions.stem: In Classic 1.12, where did the Summon Charger chain end?
questions.explanation: The Classic chain from Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker ends with Judgment and Redemption in Scholomance. Deadmines and Shadowfang Keep hold materials for Verigan's Fist.

questions.stem: Which racial gives a Dwarf Paladin +1% hit with spells and attacks?
questions.explanation: Dwarf Artisan's Precision gives +1% hit with spells and attacks. Human Ruthless gives +1% crit and Skyborne Wind-Blessed +2% haste.

questions.stem: Since the 26 October notes, what does Human Ruthless give?
questions.explanation: Ruthless was cut from 2% to +1% crit on 26 October.

questions.stem: What does the Human Spirit racial give in the 26 October notes?
questions.explanation: Humans get +10% Spirit. Ruthless is the +1% crit racial, and +2% haste is Skyborne's Wind-Blessed.

questions.stem: Which launch raid is the 40-player raid?
questions.explanation: Barrow Deeps is for 10 players, Hyjal Summit for 20 and Onyxia's Lair for 40; all three open on 9 December 2026.

questions.stem: Warcraft Tavern says a profession camp object gives a Kings-like buff. How strong is it?
questions.explanation: The camp copy gives 8% instead of the real Blessing's 10%, and it does not stack with the real buff.

questions.stem: What must every raider carry in their own bags to enter Onyxia's Lair?
questions.explanation: Every raider must carry their own Drakefire Amulet. The Bastion of Stormwind is the shield from The Tome of Valor.

questions.stem: What is Holy Shock's cooldown?
questions.explanation: Holy Shock has a 10 sec cooldown. Light's Vigil has a 6 sec cooldown and Divine Favor a 2 min one.

questions.stem: How long does Light's Vigil stay on its target?
questions.explanation: Light's Vigil lasts 30 sec on a friendly target; 6 sec is its cooldown.

questions.stem: Oath of Light adds up to 400 healing to which of your spells on the sworn ally?
questions.explanation: Oath of Light adds up to 400 to Holy Light, 115 to Flash of Light and 230 to Holy Shock.

questions.stem: With Infusion of Light at rank 1, how much do Holy Shock and Flash of Light crits cut from your next Holy Light?
questions.explanation: Rank 1 cuts 0.5 sec; rank 2 cuts 1.0 sec, for a Holy Light cast within 15 sec.

questions.stem: Purifying Power lowers the mana cost of which spells?
questions.explanation: Purifying Power cuts the mana cost of Cleanse and Purify. It shortens the cooldown of Exorcism and Holy Wrath instead.

questions.stem: At rank 2 of 2, how much of your mana regeneration does Reverence keep going while you cast?
questions.explanation: Reverence keeps 15% at rank 1 and 30% at rank 2.

questions.stem: What does Holy Power now increase?
choices: the critical healing bonus of Holy spells
questions.explanation: Holy Power raises the critical healing bonus of Holy spells by 10% per point, up to 50%. Divine Precision is the talent that adds hit with Holy spells.

questions.stem: How much hit with Holy spells does Divine Precision give at its second point?
questions.explanation: Divine Precision grants 4% or 8% hit with Holy spells.

questions.stem: Where does Spiritual Focus sit in the Holy tree?
questions.explanation: Spiritual Focus has five points on row 1; Reverence has two points on row 2.

questions.stem: According to Warcraft Tavern, which profession makes healing potions in Forever?
questions.explanation: Warcraft Tavern says healing potions moved from Alchemy to First Aid.

questions.stem: In Classic 1.12, which of these healer consumables is a flask?
questions.explanation: Flask of Distilled Wisdom heads the Classic healer kit; Elixir of the Sages is an elixir and Major Mana Potion a potion.

questions.stem: Blessing of Light is gone. Which Holy talent strengthens healing on one ally instead?
questions.explanation: Oath of Light is the Holy talent that strengthens healing on one ally. Salvation and Revoke were removed too.

questions.stem: Which resistance aura answers Blizzard's request to build resistance before Onyxia?
questions.explanation: Blizzard asks raids to build fire resistance before Onyxia, and Fire Resistance Aura now reaches raid members within 30 yards.

questions.stem: At rank 2 of 2, how much does Divine Precision shorten Silence effects on you?
questions.explanation: Divine Precision reduces Silence durations by 10% at rank 1 and 20% at rank 2.

questions.stem: Which talent shortens Fear and Disorient effects on you?
questions.explanation: Unyielding Faith, now on row 3 of the Retribution tree, shortens Fear and Disorient effects by 15% or 30%.

questions.stem: How much does Righteous Fury raise all threat?
questions.explanation: Righteous Fury raises all threat by 33% and adds a further 90% threat bonus to Holy damage.

questions.stem: From how far does judging Seal of Fury taunt?
questions.explanation: Judging Seal of Fury taunts from 10 yards. Thirty yards is the reach of the raid-wide resistance auras.

questions.stem: How much Holy damage does Holy Shield deal for each attack you block while it is active?
questions.explanation: Holy Shield deals 75 Holy damage for each blocked attack, and that damage causes 20% additional threat.

questions.stem: How long does the Forbearance from Templar's Bulwark last?
questions.explanation: Templar's Bulwark applies Forbearance for 1 min. The absorb lasts 8 sec, and the cooldown is 5 min.

questions.stem: At rank 2 of 2, how much does Sacred Duty shorten Forbearance?
questions.explanation: Sacred Duty shortens Forbearance by 5 sec at rank 1 and 10 sec at rank 2.

questions.stem: With both points in Shield Specialization, what chance does a block have to restore 4% of maximum mana?
questions.explanation: Two points give a 50% or 100% chance to restore 4% of maximum mana, and 15% or 30% more shield block value.

questions.stem: Which of these can be dispelled?
questions.explanation: Templar's Bulwark sits on row 3 and can be dispelled. Swift Judgement releases your active Seal on its own cooldown.

questions.stem: Blizzard asks raids to build fire resistance before Onyxia. What target does it set?
questions.explanation: Blizzard gives no number. The +16 and +15 values are Classic item and enchant values, not a Forever target.

questions.stem: In Classic 1.12, how much fire resistance did the Onyxia Scale Cloak give?
questions.explanation: In Classic the Onyxia Scale Cloak gave +16; the Drakefire Amulet, Juju Ember and the cloak enchant gave +15.

questions.stem: What happened to Blessing of Sanctuary in Forever?
questions.explanation: Blessing of Sanctuary is removed in Forever. Holy Shield is the talent that moved to row 5.

questions.stem: How many players does Hyjal Summit hold?
questions.explanation: Barrow Deeps holds 10, Hyjal Summit 20 and Onyxia's Lair 40.

questions.stem: Which Protection talent shortens Stun and Charm effects on you?
questions.explanation: Stoicism shortens Stun and Charm effects by 10% or 20%. Redoubt raises your block chance and Toughness your armor.

questions.stem: With Shieldsworn, how long can you block spells after Holy Strike?
questions.explanation: Shieldsworn lets you block spells for 6 sec; 4 sec is how much it cuts from Holy Strike's cooldown.

questions.stem: How much does Sacred Arbiter raise Holy Strike's damage?
questions.explanation: Sacred Arbiter adds 20% to Holy Strike and makes it refresh all Judgement effects on the target. 70% of weapon damage is Seal of Command's extra Holy damage.

questions.stem: How long does Unsealed Wrath keep a stored copy of your Seal?
questions.explanation: Stored copies last 15 sec and stack up to 3 times. 30 sec is how long Seal of Command lasts.

questions.stem: At rank 2 of 2, how much does Improved Judgement cut from Judgement's cooldown?
questions.explanation: Improved Judgement takes 1 sec off at rank 1 and 2 sec at rank 2.

questions.stem: Eye for an Eye's damage will not exceed what share of your total health?
questions.explanation: Eye for an Eye returns 5% of critical strike damage at rank 1, capped at 50% of the Paladin's total health.

questions.stem: At rank 1, how much does Vindication lower the target's Attack Power?
questions.explanation: Vindication lowers Attack Power by 68 at rank 1 and 204 at rank 3, for 30 sec.

questions.stem: Which talent lets Turn Undead affect Demons?
questions.explanation: Turn Evil shortens Turn Undead's cast time and cooldown and lets it affect Demons.

questions.stem: How much crit does Conviction add at its third point?
questions.explanation: Conviction adds 2%, 4% or 6% crit to attacks and spells.

questions.stem: Vengeance needs Seal of Command. How many times can it stack?
questions.explanation: Vengeance can stack five times. Three is Unsealed Wrath's stack limit.

questions.stem: With all three points in Two-Handed Weapon Specialization, how much does it lower your threat?
questions.explanation: It lowers threat by 7%, 14% or 20% while adding 2%, 4% or 6% Holy and Physical damage.

questions.stem: In Classic 1.12, which elixir was on the melee consumables list?
questions.explanation: Elixir of the Giants is on the Classic melee list. Elixir of the Grizzly is new in Forever.

questions.stem: What does Warcraft Tavern report Elixir of the Grizzly gives?
choices: No effect while in a raid instance
questions.explanation: Elixir of the Grizzly gives Strength plus crit. 'No effect while in a raid instance' is Wowhead's note on Rallying Cry of the Dragonslayer.

questions.stem: In the 10 November talent data, how much of your Intellect does Champion of the Light turn into spell damage at rank 5?
questions.explanation: Champion of the Light gives up to 12% of your Intellect at rank 1 and 60% at rank 5. The 10/20/30% figure from the 16 October notes is out of date.

questions.stem: Which talent now supplies Retribution's threat reduction?
questions.explanation: Instrument of Law was removed; Two-Handed Weapon Specialization now lowers Retribution's threat.

questions.stem: Repentance only works against which targets?
questions.explanation: Repentance incapacitates Humanoids for up to 6 sec. Demons are what Turn Evil adds to Turn Undead.

questions.stem: You judge Seal of Command on a target that is stunned or incapacitated. How much Holy damage does it deal?
questions.explanation: The Judgement deals 68 to 73 Holy damage, or 137 to 145 if the target is stunned or incapacitated.

questions.stem: Against a Hunter, what does Scorpid Sting now do?
choices: lowers the target's hit chance by 2%
questions.explanation: Scorpid Sting now lowers the target's hit chance by 2%. Disengage is the ability that drops twice as much threat.
